name: Dagannoth

variantInfo.name: Dagannoth
notes: The standard task Dagannoth appear as level 74 and level 92 variants with 70 and 120 Slayer XP respectively.
Some level 74 Dagannoth in the Lighthouse attack with range; in the Catacombs and Jormungand's Prison all standard Dagannoth attack with melee.
They are much weaker than their combat level suggests and have a 35% earth spell weakness.

variantInfo.name: Dagannoth (Waterbirth Island)
notes: Waterbirth Island has stronger level 88 ranged Dagannoth worth 85 Slayer XP and level 90 melee Dagannoth worth 99.6 Slayer XP.
The level 88 ranged variant attacks quickly and accurately with range 4; the level 90 melee variant hits accurately and hard.
Both Waterbirth variants ignore player and monster collision and have a 35% earth spell weakness.

variantInfo.name: Dagannoth spawn
notes: Dagannoth spawn hatch from eggs near the walls or water while nearby Dagannoth are still aggressive.
They are always aggressive but are not recommended for Slayer tasks because regular Dagannoth give more experience with little extra difficulty.

variantInfo.name: Dagannoth fledgeling
notes: Located in Bardur's room deep in Waterbirth Island Dungeon.
Not useful for training because they give no combat or Slayer experience and are busy fighting Bardur.

variantInfo.name: Dagannoth Prime
locations: Deep within the Waterbirth Island Dungeon
notes: Dagannoth King using magic attacks; fight it with Ranged and keep Protect from Magic active.
Typically killed on task for Slayer helmet or black mask bonuses and valuable ring-slot drops.

variantInfo.name: Dagannoth Rex
locations: Deep within the Waterbirth Island Dungeon
notes: Dagannoth King using melee attacks; fight it with Magic and safespot or pray Protect from Melee.
Can be killed alone from safespots and is commonly hunted for the Berserker ring.

variantInfo.name: Dagannoth Supreme
locations: Deep within the Waterbirth Island Dungeon
notes: Dagannoth King using ranged attacks; fight it with Melee and pray Protect from Missiles.
Usually fought as part of a tribrid Dagannoth Kings rotation.

variantInfo.name: Reanimated dagannoth
notes: Counts for the corresponding Slayer task, giving 35 Slayer XP alongside Prayer XP.
Incidental reanimation target requiring the relevant Arceuus reanimation spell and ensouled head; not an independently spawned repeatable monster.
Reanimation works near the original drop while the head has not entered a bank, trade, Grand Exchange or price checker; otherwise use the Dark Altar.

locationComparison.name: Catacombs of Kourend
notes: The Dagannoth are located in the southern section of the Catacombs of Kourend.
No dwarf cannon can be used, but the melee-only Dagannoth support prayer AFK and difficult safespots.

locationComparison.name: Jormungand's Prison
notes: Only accessible after completing The Fremennik Exiles.
Common location for cannoning Dagannoth.
Dagannoth here only use melee attacks, making Protect from Melee simple.

locationComparison.name: Lighthouse Dungeon
notes: Usually busy with players using a dwarf cannon.
Can offer some of the fastest slayer experience in the game.
Good for maximising AFK time without relying on prayer.

locationComparison.name: Waterbirth Island Dungeon
notes: Contains stronger Dagannoth than the other task locations plus 3 Dagannoth Kings deeper in the dungeon.
The entrance is not multicombat; reaching the multicombat zones normally requires a pet rock or Humphrey dumphrey and a ranged weapon or another player.
Trigger nearby eggs while Dagannoth remain aggressive to hatch dagannoth spawn and speed the task every few minutes.
A skeleton can be used to safespot north-east of the dungeon entrance after NPC aggression expires.
Reaching the Dagannoth Kings requires extra preparation.

taskNotes: Dagannoth require 75 combat and completion of Horror from the Deep to be assigned.
They are known for high slayer experience rates and easy task completions.
The Lighthouse basement is a strong AFK choice and allows a dwarf cannon in multicombat.
Jormungand's Prison is a common cannon location after The Fremennik Exiles because all Dagannoth there use melee.
Catacombs of Kourend cannot be cannoned, but prayer-boosting melee gear and prayer potions allow AFK kills with Auto Retaliate.
Dinh's bulwark special attack with Lightbearer can refresh aggression in the Catacombs without leaving the area.
Waterbirth Island has stronger Dagannoth; dagannoth spawn can be triggered from nearby eggs while the monsters are still aggressive.
Dagannoth Kings are a rewarding alternative on a normal Dagannoth task or a Konar Waterbirth Island assignment.
80 Agility with a Summer pie boost or 85 Agility for shortcuts and Elite Fremennik Diary for noted Dagannoth bones make Dagannoth Kings much better.
Expert Reanimation on ensouled dagannoth heads can train Prayer during a task, but it lowers combat and Slayer experience rates.
Dagannoth frequently drop herb seeds, so bringing a seed box is recommended.
recommendedMethod: Use cannon + melee at the Lighthouse or Jormungand's Prison for fast tasks; use Catacombs prayer AFK for low effort; kill Dagannoth Kings for profit and Slayer helm bonuses when prepared.
